source_priority_note: Operative statute controls; guidance never overrides statute.

sources.excerpt: ADU, JADU, livable-space, local-agency, objective-standard, public-transit, single-family, and multifamily predicates are defined for Chapter 13.
sources.title: California Government Code §66313 definitions

sources.excerpt: A compliant local ordinance uses ministerial objective standards, caps parking at one space per unit or bedroom, limits side and rear setbacks to four feet, protects replacement parking, coordinates garage demolition, and limits sprinkler requirements.
sources.title: California Government Code §66314 local ordinance limits

sources.excerpt: Section 66314 supplies the maximum standards for a single-family-lot ADU; an owner-occupant requirement may not be imposed except for the qualified-buyer sale path, while rentals may be restricted to terms longer than 30 days.
sources.title: California Government Code §66315 occupancy and rental limits

sources.excerpt: A permitting agency considers and approves or denies a complete ADU application ministerially within 60 days and supplies a complete defect list and remedies upon denial.
sources.title: California Government Code §66317 ministerial process

sources.excerpt: Local size, coverage, FAR, open-space, minimum-lot-size, and front-setback rules cannot preclude an 800-square-foot ADU with four-foot side and rear setbacks. Local maxima must permit 850 square feet, or 1,000 with more than one bedroom. Detached height floors are 16 feet, 18 feet under transit or multistory-multifamily predicates, plus up to two roof-pitch feet under the transit predicate; attached height is 25 feet or the primary-dwelling zoning limit, whichever is lower.
sources.title: California Government Code §66321 size and height floors

sources.excerpt: Parking is prohibited for enumerated transit, historic, conversion, permit, car-share, and paired-primary-application cases. Unaffected nonconforming zoning conditions and non-safety building conditions cannot be required to be corrected as an ADU condition.
sources.title: California Government Code §66322 parking and nonconformity

sources.excerpt: In 2026, the state-mandated single-family combination includes one conversion ADU, one JADU, and one detached new-construction ADU up to 800 square feet. Multifamily conversion units are at least one and up to 25 percent of existing units; detached units are up to eight for existing multifamily, capped by existing units, or up to two for proposed multifamily. Only standards authorized by §66323 apply.
sources.title: California Government Code §66323 operative 2026 state-mandated units

sources.excerpt: A JADU is no more than 500 square feet within a proposed or existing single-family residence, has an efficiency kitchen and exterior access, may share sanitation, requires owner occupancy only when sanitation is shared subject to entity exceptions, requires rentals longer than 30 days, and requires no parking.
sources.title: California Government Code §§66333-66339 JADUs

sources.excerpt: Separate sale is generally outside the ordinary path; §66341 supplies a bounded qualified-nonprofit and qualified-buyer conveyance path with deed and occupancy conditions.
sources.title: California Government Code §66341 qualified nonprofit conveyance

sources.excerpt: HCD explains operative 2026 law, including four §66323 categories, combinability, size and height floors, parking exemptions, fire-sprinkler limits, owner occupancy, rental terms, and ministerial timing. Statute controls any inconsistency.
sources.title: HCD Accessory Dwelling Unit Handbook

sources.excerpt: The City links the updated matrix and HCD handbook, states it complies with state housing laws when effective, accepts applications through MaintStar, and requires project-specific plans, energy calculations, and supplemental documents for preapproved plans.
sources.title: City of La Mesa Accessory Dwelling Units

sources.excerpt: The 2026 matrix identifies single-family local, conversion, detached, and JADU paths; multifamily conversion and detached formulas; a 1,200-square-foot local maximum, 50-percent attached relationship, four-foot side/rear setbacks, zone-based height presentation, 40-percent single-family coverage subject to the state floor, no ADU parking, current occupancy/rental treatment, and fire-review language.
sources.title: City of La Mesa ADU and JADU Development Matrix

sources.excerpt: Title 24 supplies definitions, residential base standards, mapped overlays, grading and safety controls, and specific-plan interactions. Its general development standards remain subject to later controlling state ADU law.
sources.title: La Mesa Municipal Code Title 24

sources.excerpt: La Mesa accepts permit applications and plans electronically through MaintStar and administers the 2025 California Building Standards Code cycle effective January 1, 2026.
sources.title: City of La Mesa Building and MaintStar guidance

sources.excerpt: The guide predates later statutory changes and is supporting context only; it cannot override the 2026 statutes, HCD handbook, or 2026 City matrix.
sources.title: La Mesa Accessory Dwelling Unit Guidebook

sources.excerpt: Beginning January 1, 2027, the single-family state-mandated detached new-construction count changes from one to two; a local agency need not approve a JADU on the same lot where those two detached units have been constructed. The 800-square-foot and applicable height/setback conditions remain.
sources.title: AB 956, Chapter 791, Statutes of 2026
